description: Summarize a block of text into a concise paragraph.
promptText:
Summarize the following text into a concise paragraph (3-5 sentences), capturing the key points:

{{text}}

description: Classify a message into a sentiment label.
promptText:
Classify the sentiment of the following message as positive, negative, or neutral. Reply with a single word.

{{message}}

description: Translate text into a target language.
promptText:
Translate the following text into {{language}}. Reply with the translation only.

{{text}}

description: Extract a bullet list of action items from notes.
promptText:
Extract every action item and TODO from the following notes as a markdown bullet list. If there are none, reply with "No action items found."

{{notes}}

description: Run a free-form prompt through the LLM and post the result.
